{{Quote|Stay here. Let me call my supervisor.|Unidentified female Pop-Dog to Husin|<ref name="MK" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the [[Pop-Dogs]], an elite unit of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> she was stationed at the [[Major Saving's Army Surplus]] store in [[Kura City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]]. The store acted as an entrance to the underground mines which her leader, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]], used to store materials for his illicit [[Black market/Legends|black market]] activities.<ref name="MK" />  

Members of [[Wraith Squadron]], a recently reformed Galactic Alliance [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, planted an unconscious [[Ledina Chott]], a famous pop [[Musician/Legends|singer]] they had kidnapped, inside the store as part of their [[Mission to Kuratooine|mission]] to expose Thaal's corruption. Chott's location was discovered by [[Kadd Yinkle]], a [[Technician/Legends|technician]] from a security firm that had engaged Chott as a client. Yinkle and his colleagues had traced Chott's rescue transmitter to the store. When Yinkle, accompanied by [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] [[Husin]] and [[Biller]], inquired at the entrance, the female Pop-Dog was the one who came out and answered. Husin invoked the [[Uniform Planetary Code]] to search the premises without a warrant and the Pop-Dog responded that she would have to inform her supervisor first. As she tried to close the automated doorway, Husin stepped in between and was slammed into the jamb. The Pop-Dog ran into a desk and drew a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]], but was shot in the ribs by Biller with her [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="MK" /> 

==Equipment==
The Pop-Dog had a hold-out blaster that she tried to use against Husin.<ref name="MK" />

==Behind the scenes==
The female Pop-Dog was created by [[Aaron Allston]] for his [[2012]] novel ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'', the tenth volume in the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] series.<ref name="MK" />
